revision_note: The final changes after baseline MPI validation only tighten source-checkpoint metadata/time verification and its tests; Fourier synthesis, sampling, projection, mesh precision, flow equations and integration timing are unchanged. Both representations and checkpoint paths were rerun on the final restart implementation.
run_directory_note: Directory label 6f8040b identifies the initial M4 candidate; tested revisions are recorded independently.

criteria.purpose: Milestone 4 criteria fixed before the numerical runs
notes: Exact realization and repeated coefficients are required within one build; projected traces have polynomial approximation error.
MPI field bounds account for reductions, iterative residual tolerance 1e-12, and pressure conditioning/time differentiation.
Restart flow history is reinitialized by the native IMEX integrator; compare bounded evolved error and timestep refinement, separately from exact inlet reconstruction.
Do not lower an acceptance standard after inspecting a failed result; diagnose representation, mapping, solver tolerance, or resolution.

acceptance.note: No numeric acceptance bound was changed. The pre-run note mentioning 1e-12 records the initial tolerance, which was tightened after its full-3D MPI comparison failed.

limitations: Transient small-band integration inputs establish representations/transforms/MPI/restart behavior; they do not validate downstream HIT decay or the Comte-Bellot--Corrsin experiment.
Only straight-sided axis-aligned box fixtures were numerically exercised. The generic precision fix covers XML vertices; native curved-edge/face serialization remains unchanged.
HDF5 is disabled in this authoritative build; checkpoint validation here uses native XML serial and parallel fields.
Restart reconstructs the inlet phase and realization but reinitializes native IMEX multistep history; evolved fields are checked by bounds and timestep refinement, not bitwise equality.

FFTW_dependency.preparation: apt-get download libfftw3-dev; dpkg-deb --extract into isolated experiment storage; no system package changes
